author: Sofia Alvarez Entertainment Editor
title: Detective Precure Sets Crossover With Ojamajo Doremi
text:
Television schedules for Detective Precure! are shifting toward an unexpected crossover as the magical-girl franchise crosses paths with Ojamajo Doremi . Producers announced that the upcoming October 25, 2026 broadcast will feature a dedicated one-episode collaboration marking the first time the two long-running franchises have formally crossed over.
A Time-Slip Premise Built on a 1999 Shared Era The crossover draws directly from the chronological setting of the current broadcast series Detective Precure! , which follows protagonist Miko Achi who time-slips from the year 2027 back to 1999. Because the original Ojamajo Doremi series also debuted on television in February 1999, the production team used that calendar alignment to bridge the two universes.
THE PROPHECY WAS FORETOLD OJAMAJO DOREMI X STAR DETECTIVE PRECURE COLLAB BECAUSE TANPRE TAKES PLACE IN 1999 pic.twitter.com/T4y6SetRuu
— https://x.com/doreimani/status/2110900477974253613 Within the narrative of the 1999-era Makotomirai City, Ojamajo Doremi exists as a widely popular television show watched by local residents. That universe-within-a-universe detail provides the logical foothold for the special event, which unfolds as an eventful Halloween story right before the late-October date.
According to production details, the historical lineage links back to when Ojamajo Doremi aired four consecutive television blocks ending in January 2003, followed sequentially by Nadja of the Tomorrow and eventually the debut of the first Precure series in February 2004.
Costume Shifts and Detective Agency Hijinks in Episode 39 During the milestone 39th episode, the core quartet from the Curette Detective Agency find themselves preparing for the town’s inaugural neighborhood Halloween event. While attempting to track down a lost young girl named Hinano and recovering a magical broom belonging to her, the young detectives run into a disguise-wearing adversary named Ageseine.
Photo: Famitsu Because their standard outfits have already been spotted during the pursuit, the detectives decide to adopt fresh disguises to avoid detection. They choose to dress as the apprentice witches from Ojamajo Doremi , donning signature outfits corresponding to the classic magical characters.
Miko Achi takes on the appearance of Doremi. Mikuru Kobayashi mirrors Hazuki. Kurea Hane assumes the style of Aiko. Ruruka Moria matches Onpu. Design assets released alongside the announcement reveal that the four characters undergo full visual transformations matching the classic 1999 anime style, complete with playful character nicknames such as Annatchi, Mikurutchi, Kureatchi, and Rurukatchi.
Producer Perspectives on a Cross-Generational Handover Behind the scenes, the collaboration brought together veteran creators and younger staff members who grew up watching the original magical-girl broadcast. Producer Soya Aramaki noted that crafting an in-universe crossover presented distinct creative hurdles given the contrasting worlds.
Photo: オリコンニュース We are very happy to realize a collaboration with Ojamajo Doremi, our great senior in the Nichiasa block! Doing an in-universe anime collaboration while each has a different worldview was quite a difficult challenge, but we structured the collaboration around the year 1999, which is a characteristic feature of Detective Precure!, treating Ojamajo Doremi as the TV anime broadcasting at that time.
Because the classic characters appear as fictional television figures within the 1999 setting rather than crossing over literally in the flesh, producer Hiromi Seki reflected on watching staff members who were children in 1999 now helm a new generation of Sunday-morning animation.
Special Artwork, Commemorative Merchandise, and Campaign Details To mark the broadcast, original character designer Yoshihiko Umakoshi created a bespoke key visual depicting an encounter between Cure Answer and Doremi. That artwork serves as the centerpiece for an extensive merchandise rollout managed across several manufacturers.

For instance, BSS Sanin Broadcasting has scheduled the special crossover episode for broadcast on November 1, 2026.
